name: settings
description: Runtime, operator-editable configuration: resolve a typed setting from an env override → a persisted store value → a safe default, with a short in-memory cache (live within the window, immediate after a write) and fail-safe decoding. Persistence and env are injected; the newest-row-wins app_settings pattern is documented. Zero-dependency pure core.

adapters.name: memory-store
adapters.desc: An in-memory SettingsStore for dev/tests, plus the documented Postgres app_settings (newest-row-wins) pattern in its header.
